title: The plan check fails a kept social row whose icon cannot draw its linked profile (R26)
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm both tests named in run.tests report ok.
expect: On the released JA Boxing kit, block-171.10 (a twitter icon) linked to a TikTok profile fails R26 with a message to hide the row or link a twitter profile.
A twitter or x profile on that row, a YouTube profile on the telegram row (the family can draw fa-youtube), a hidden link and a hidden block all pass R26.

tests: R26 fails a twitter row linked to a profile the template has no icon for, and says how to fix the plan
R26 passes a row of its own network, a network the icon family can draw, and a row that is not shown
